question: For the station that had the highest number of Citibike trips starting there in 2018, which numeric day of the week and which hour of the day had the greatest number of trips based on the start time of those trips?
sql:
WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY start_station_name
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
station_trips AS (
  SELECT t.starttime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips` t, top_station ts
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.starttime) = 2018
    AND t.start_station_name = ts.start_station_name
),
dow_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM starttime) AS dow, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM station_trips
  GROUP BY dow
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
hour_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM station_trips
  GROUP BY hr
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.dow AS day_of_week, h.hr AS hour_of_day
FROM dow_counts d, hour_counts h
